mapper.select: SELECT a.id attemptId,p.candidate_name name,a.attempt_no attemptNo,a.submitted_at submittedAt FROM assessment_attempt a JOIN assessment_task t ON t.id=a.task_id JOIN assessment_participant p ON p.id=a.participant_id WHERE t.id=#{taskId} AND t.created_by=#{owner} AND a.status='PENDING_REVIEW' ORDER BY a.submitted_at,a.id

SELECT q.question_id questionId,q.snapshot_stem stem,q.snapshot_answer referenceAnswer, ans.answer_text answer,q.score maxScore FROM assessment_attempt_question q JOIN assessment_attempt a ON a.id=q.attempt_id JOIN assessment_task t ON t.id=a.task_id LEFT JOIN assessment_answer ans ON ans.attempt_id=a.id AND ans.question_id=q.question_id WHERE a.id=#{attemptId} AND t.id=#{taskId} AND t.created_by=#{owner} AND a.status='PENDING_REVIEW' AND q.snapshot_type='SHORT_ANSWER' ORDER BY q.sort_no,q.id
SELECT a.status FROM assessment_attempt a JOIN assessment_task t ON t.id=a.task_id WHERE a.id=#{attemptId} AND t.id=#{taskId} AND t.created_by=#{owner} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assessment_answer(attempt_id,question_id,answer_text,correct_answer,is_correct,score) VALUES(#{attemptId},#{question.questionId},'',#{question.referenceAnswer},#{correct},#{score}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_correct=VALUES(is_correct),score=VALUES(score)
mapper.update: UPDATE assessment_attempt SET status='SUBMITTED',score=#{score},passed=#{passed}, reviewed_by=#{owner},reviewed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id=#{attemptId} AND status='PENDING_REVIEW'
